title: Reproducing Thornton et al. 2022: germanium running down the oxidizing sidewall of SiGe fins

sample.paper: “Alternating, undoped 15-nm-thick Si/Si0.7Ge0.3 layers ... Each layer Si and Si0.7Ge0.3 was repeated four times, for a total of eight layers.”
sample.ours: COMPOSITION: Si0.7Ge0.3; FILM recorded, read by no program
sample.note: The programs see one infinite Si0.7Ge0.3 alloy; the Si layers between, and the 15 nm thickness of each alloy layer, are invisible to them.

sample.paper: “The SiGe layers were strained and all layers were pseudomorphic.”
sample.note: The paper rules strain out as the cause (4.3 eV for strained interdiffusion, PDF p. 8); no program could have tested it.

sample.paper: “widths varying from 70 to 280 nm and approximately 5 µm long”; “approximately 230 nm tall”; top 120 nm superlattice, 110 nm Si base
sample.note: The SiGe programs read SHAPE only to label nanosheet and nanowire samples outside their scope; a fin is run as a planar alloy with no label.

sample.paper: not stated (a (100) wafer; fin axis not given)
sample.ours: ORIENTATION: Si110 on the silicon-base cases (assumed); Si100 on the fin

sample.paper: native oxide, no Ge along it before oxidation (Figure 2a); no clean stated
sample.ours: CLEAN: not_stated; each program's own starting oxide

history.item: Four periods of 15 nm Si / 15 nm Si0.7Ge0.3 by CVD on 300 mm (100) Si
history.paper: “Alternating, undoped 15-nm-thick Si/Si0.7Ge0.3 layers were grown on a nominally undoped (<1e16), 300 mm (100) Si wafer using an Applied Materials Centura chemical vapor deposition (CVD) system.” “The SiGe layers were strained and all layers were pseudomorphic.”
history.ours: COMPOSITION Si0.7Ge0.3 on the sample; the superlattice is a FILM string read by no program

history.item: Electron-beam lithography: fins 70-280 nm wide, about 5 µm long
history.paper: “patterned into fins via electron beam lithography using the Nanoscale Pattern Generation System (NPGS) with widths varying from 70 to 280 nm and approximately 5 µm long”
history.ours: SHAPE: fin on the sample; width of the measured fins not stated

history.item: Bosch deep reactive ion etch, 60 s: fins about 230 nm tall
history.paper: “a continuous deep reactive ion Bosch etch was carried out for 60 s to form fins approximately 230 nm tall. The top 120 nm was comprised of the alternating, 15-nm-thick Si/SiGe superlattice while the 110 nm at the fin base was from the Si substrate.”
history.ours: recorded; no program reads a fin height

history.paper: “there is no Ge present along the interface between the Si and the native oxide” (Figure 2a); no clean before oxidation is stated
“Oxidations at 750°C, 800°C, 850°C, and 900°C were carried out in a conventional tube furnace with dry O2 flowing.”

history.ours: RUN RampUp DURATION 300 TEMP 600->900 AMBIENT dry_O2

history.paper: “Oxidations at 750°C, 800°C, 850°C, and 900°C were carried out in a conventional tube furnace with dry O2 flowing.”; times from Figure 4 (5, 10, 20 min at 900 °C) and the √t axis of Figure 5
history.ours: RUN Oxidation DURATION 600 TEMP 900->900 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: Dry O2 flowing; pressure not stated, 1 atm assumed.

history.ours: RUN RampDown DURATION 300 TEMP 900->600 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: Five minutes down to 600 °C is ours.

history.paper: “the lamellae were cleaned for 5 minutes using a benchtop GV10x plasma cleaner”

history.item: HAADF-STEM length and width of the Ge contrast; EDS end point at about 3% Ge
history.paper: “the Ge diffusion width and length were measured four times at each respective time/temperature. The end point of the length measurement was defined to be when the contrast due to the Ge content tapered to no longer being detectable via eye or intensity line scans. This point was determined to correspond to a Ge concentration of ~3% by EDS”
history.ours: no observable: no program reports a length along the sidewall

history.paper: “the diffusion length of a sample that was oxidized and then subsequently annealed in forming gas was compared to that of a sample that was oxidized for the same amount of time”
history.ours: not written: temperature and times are in the supplement, which is not in the PDF

steps.label: HAADF-STEM length and width of the Ge contrast; EDS end point at about 3% Ge
steps.paper: “the Ge diffusion width and length were measured four times at each respective time/temperature. The end point of the length measurement was defined to be when the contrast due to the Ge content tapered to no longer being detectable via eye or intensity line scans. This point was determined to correspond to a Ge concentration of ~3% by EDS”

cases.label: Si fin base sidewall, 900 °C, 10 min, sealed ampule (~35 mtorr)
cases.note: The control without flowing oxygen. The residual gas is written as air at 35 mtorr; the paper does not say what it was.

steps.name: Growth
steps.label: Four periods of 15 nm Si / 15 nm Si0.7Ge0.3 by CVD on 300 mm (100) Si
steps.paper: “Alternating, undoped 15-nm-thick Si/Si0.7Ge0.3 layers were grown on a nominally undoped (<1e16), 300 mm (100) Si wafer using an Applied Materials Centura chemical vapor deposition (CVD) system.” “The SiGe layers were strained and all layers were pseudomorphic.”
steps.timing: Growth temperature and time not stated

steps.name: Pattern
steps.label: Electron-beam lithography: fins 70-280 nm wide, about 5 µm long
steps.paper: “patterned into fins via electron beam lithography using the Nanoscale Pattern Generation System (NPGS) with widths varying from 70 to 280 nm and approximately 5 µm long”

steps.name: Etch
steps.label: Bosch deep reactive ion etch, 60 s: fins about 230 nm tall
steps.paper: “a continuous deep reactive ion Bosch etch was carried out for 60 s to form fins approximately 230 nm tall. The top 120 nm was comprised of the alternating, 15-nm-thick Si/SiGe superlattice while the 110 nm at the fin base was from the Si substrate.”

steps.name: Storage
steps.label: Native oxide on the fin
steps.paper: “there is no Ge present along the interface between the Si and the native oxide” (Figure 2a); no clean before oxidation is stated
steps.timing: Time between etch and oxidation, and any clean or polymer removal, not stated

steps.name: Load
steps.label: Sealed in a quartz ampule pumped to about 35 mtorr
steps.paper: “a fin with only the native oxide present was encapsulated in a quartz ampule, which was then vacuum sealed”; “it was only pumped to ~35 mtorr”
steps.timing: Load temperature, push rate and gas not stated

steps.name: RampUp
steps.label: Push and heat-up (not described)
steps.isl: RUN RampUp DURATION 300 TEMP 600->900 AMBIENT mix:O2=9.6e-06,N2=3.6e-05
steps.paper: not stated

steps.name: Oxidation
steps.label: Anneal in the sealed ampule, 900 °C, 10 min
steps.isl: RUN Oxidation DURATION 600 TEMP 900->900 AMBIENT mix:O2=9.6e-06,N2=3.6e-05
steps.paper: “The sealed quartz ampule was annealed at 900°C for 10 minutes”; residual gas at ~35 mtorr, composition not stated (air assumed: O2 9.6e-6 atm, N2 3.6e-5 atm)

steps.name: RampDown
steps.label: Pull and cool-down (not described)
steps.isl: RUN RampDown DURATION 300 TEMP 900->600 AMBIENT mix:O2=9.6e-06,N2=3.6e-05
steps.paper: not stated

steps.name: Section
steps.label: FIB lamella, 5 min plasma clean
steps.paper: “the lamellae were cleaned for 5 minutes using a benchtop GV10x plasma cleaner”

steps.paper: “the Ge diffusion width and length were measured four times at each respective time/temperature. The end point of the length measurement was defined to be when the contrast due to the Ge content tapered to no longer being detectable via eye or intensity line scans. This point was determined to correspond to a Ge concentration of ~3% by EDS”
